calls.statement:
SELECT store_id, store_name, city
FROM dim_store
WHERE LOWER(store_name) LIKE '%nokia%' OR LOWER(city) LIKE '%nokia%'
AND is_current = TRUE
calls.output_preview:
store_id | store_name | city
118 | Nokia | Nokia
(1 row)

calls.statement:
SELECT 
    p.subcategory,
    SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE s.store_id = 118
    AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
    AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.subcategory
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
calls.output_preview:
subcategory | units_sold
Fixings & Fasteners | 570
Indoor Lighting | 152
Storage Boxes | 139
(3 rows)

calls.statement:
WITH period_5_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        p.subcategory,
        SUM(f.quantity) AS total_units
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    INNER JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
    INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 118
        AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
        AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
    GROUP BY p.subcategory
)
SELECT subcategory, total_units
FROM period_5_sales
ORDER BY total_units DESC
LIMIT 3
calls.output_preview:
subcategory | total_units
Fixings & Fasteners | 570
Indoor Lighting | 152
Storage Boxes | 139
(3 rows)
